claims.name: Authority
claims.question: Can a participant widen authority, combine unrelated grants, substitute an identity or resource, escape scope, or reset an ancestor limit?

claims.name: Trusted inputs
claims.question: Can hostile input select weaker trust, policy, verifier configuration, evidence, clock or an obsolete installation?

claims.name: Exact effect
claims.question: Does the provider request follow only verified canonical inputs and the exact approved compiled effect?

claims.name: Approval
claims.question: Are quorum identities distinct, authorized, signature-valid, action-bound and fresh at the required boundary? Is presentation complete?

claims.name: Confidentiality
claims.question: Can the attacker obtain provider/signing credentials, protected content or unauthorized disclosure through any reachable interface?

claims.name: Conservation
claims.question: Do concurrency and failures preserve the applicable count, sum, ancestor, task and operation allocations without partial admission?

claims.name: Revocation
claims.question: Do all participating writers and entry paths obey the stated revocation/configuration linearization rule?

claims.name: Replay
claims.question: Can replay, aliasing, another executor, restart, a fresh challenge or retained history produce unauthorized new entry?

claims.name: Recovery
claims.question: Do uncertain outcomes retain conservative accounting and require separate current read authority, without blind write retry or redelivery?

claims.name: Evidence
claims.question: Can an auditor reproduce the authorization under independent trust and distinguish the actual strength of execution evidence?

claims.name: Input and artifact integrity
claims.question: Do malformed/bounded inputs and installed bindings preserve the native contract, and do assessed artifacts match their claimed source/features?

claims.name: Deployment and operations
claims.question: Do effective isolation, provisioning, time, storage, rotation and restoration satisfy the advertised trust model?
